mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement (title, content, audience, target_team_id, target_user_id, created_by, recipient_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{audience}, #{targetTeamId}, #{targetUserId}, #{createdBy}, #{recipientCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET recipient_count = #{recipientCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.audience, a.target_team_id, a.target_user_id, a.created_by, a.recipient_count, a.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_notification n WHERE n.dedupe_key = CONCAT('announcement:', a.id)) AS delivered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_notification n WHERE n.dedupe_key = CONCAT('announcement:', a.id) AND n.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS read_count FROM announcement a
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement a
a.created_by = #{createdBy}
